notes: Use-cases: contract ingestion + clause search, redlining assistant (chat), bulk summarization of bundles.
Latency SLO target: 95th <=150ms for short-turn chat (<=128 tokens); p99 target <=350ms — customer wants p99 contractual.
Throughput target: steady 120 qps of short chats during business hours; batch jobs overnight for large summarizations.
Context length requirement: ability to handle 200k token combined context (long-doc retrieval) — POC used chained retrieval + chunked context; wants 64k native if possible.
Model preferences: prefer open models (Llama-family, Mistral) but will consider fine-tuned closed models if latency/cost improve. Ask about Redwood-verified quantization profile.
Quantization: need accuracy comparison for 4-bit/q4_0 vs q8_0 for legal NER/phrase detection; risk tolerance low.
KV cache/batching: want KV cache sticky per customer session; recommended continuous batching for throughput but must preserve per-session KV isolation.
Reserved GPU ask: initial proposal 8xA100-40GB equiv for steady-state with ability to burst to 16; AE asked for pricing for 8 vs 12 vs 16 tiers.
"We can't tolerate data leaving our VPC" — repeated by CTO on 11/02 call.
Security: strict retention controls, legal wants 7-year audit logs + KMS integration + SAML SSO.
POC notes: ran Dedicated perf tests with context window 64k (simulated) using quantized variants; accuracy drop of 1.2% on clause classification for q4 baseline.
Internal stakeholders: CTO (Maya Lin), Head of ML (Arjun Patel), Procurement lead (Helena Crowe).
Competitive check: evaluating Redwood vs self-host on GCP + Anthropic deploys; main deciders: latency predictability and contractual SLAs.
poc_results_summary: p95 latency 140ms on 128-token queries with batching=32, kv_cache enabled.
p99 latency 420ms during synthetic 3x burst; with autoscale to +4 GPUs p99 reduced to 210ms.
Embeddings throughput 450 req/s on single quantized model instance (batching 256).
Quantization accuracy: q4_0 ~-1.2% vs fp16 on clause classification; q8_0 ~-0.4%.
Cost estimate: dedicated 8-GPU monthly ~ $65k; incremental burst pricing per GPU-hour shown in deck.
